we employ a Generative Reward Model (GenRM) and design Final Answer Preference (FAP) to efficiently collect preference signals, while also collecting Stepwise Corrective Preference (SCP) by asking the GenRM to identify and correct the first erroneous step.
We prompt the GenRM to give a holistic judgment for the entire solution using a single "Yes" or "No" token.
